AI classify-job returns 'plumbing' for sink description with confidence within bounds; role guard returns 403 for pros. Quote creation does NOT log a fee; accept does (status=pending, monthly_fees incremented, other quotes auto-declined, job → in_progress, accepted_pro_user_id/pro_user_id exposed). Share-location requires in_progress (400 otherwise), persists address, and contact endpoint returns pro+homeowner+address+location_shared. Portfolio max 10 enforced (11th = 400 'Maximum 10 photos allowed') + delete works. cancel-subscription returns 400 when on Standard. pay-outstanding returns Stripe URL + creates payment_transactions row with metadata.type=contact_fees. /api/search?q=sink returns jobs+pros arrays. /api/messages/thread now returns other_pro_id. Frontend: homeowner login → / works; PostJobPage AI banner appears within seconds showing 'AI suggests: Plumbing (99%)' with Use this button; /search?q=sink renders 5 results; header search input + Enter navigates to /search; /messages thread page shows Contact-Info-Unlocked card (email pro@test.com, address shared) AND the month-grid Schedule-an-appointment calendar always visible below the message composer with dots on availability days, prev/next month navigation present. Settings → Portfolio tab loads with file input. All critical iter2 acceptance criteria pass.

issues: Homeowner seeded user has no phone → 'Phone not provided' shown without Call/WhatsApp buttons (correct conditional UI). Consider seeding a phone for test users so the Call/WhatsApp buttons can be exercised E2E.

'Enable browser notifications' button is conditional on Notification.permission==='default'. In headless Chromium this is 'denied', so the button wasn't visible. This is expected; manual verification in a real browser is recommended.

action_items: (Optional) Seed homeowner@test.com with a phone number so the Call/WhatsApp buttons on the homeowner-side contact card can be exercised in automated tests.

(Optional) The 'Enable browser notifications' button only renders when Notification.permission==='default'. Consider exposing a data-testid='enable-browser-notif' so future tests can detect its absence vs. wrong state.
critical_code_review_comments: billing_routes.get_checkout_status: when payment_status=='paid' and the txn is type=contact_fees, the route uses current user's pro profile to recompute monthly_fees. If a different user opens the success URL with someone else's session_id, the fee_log update still happens but monthly_fees would be recomputed on the wrong pro. Consider deriving the pro from the transaction.user_id stored at creation rather than the requester.
ai_routes.classify-job uses session_id=f'classify-{user["_id"]}' — fine, but consider rate-limiting per user to avoid abuse since each call costs an LLM token.

job_routes.share-location stores the message kind='location' but the inbox renders it as plain text emoji ('📍 Address shared: ...'). A typed renderer would let the UI show a styled location card consistently.

Portfolio storage as base64 inside pro_profiles document risks blowing past Mongo's 16MB doc limit at scale (10 × ~600KB ≈ 6MB plus other fields). Consider GridFS or S3-style external storage for prod.
